plainSummary: The workflow requirements now link to checks for saving choices safely and keeping required proof in place.
summary: Reviewed acceptance mappings added to W012 against SL030 and b-sl-030. All three criteria share the workflow-editor integration binding, which runs independent bridge/domain negative tests, UI draft validation/rendering tests and navigation regressions. These establish enforced outputs, preview freshness and request denial; actual browser editor create/preview/apply, keyboard/narrow width and CLI/MCP lifecycle observation remain necessary supplemental acceptance evidence. Spec narrative and security boundaries unchanged from SR01.
residualRisks: Tool related pack supplied a caution-only worktree note without scan status or entries; no sibling checkout state was used as authority.
No code has been independently verified at spec review time; cross-origin rejection and unchanged selections require runtime negative tests.
Saving guidance does not establish agent compliance or launch a host runner; local filesystem writers remain outside the cooperative boundary.
